Location: Birmingham, Alabama

History: On Sept. 15, 1963, four little black girls were killed when KKK members bombed the 16th Street Baptist Church. Fourteen other church members were injured, and two boys were killed in subsequent riots. The horrific attack prompted responses from MLK Jr. and President John F. Kennedy. 

The church is active to this day, and four bronze statues commemorate the four little girls.
